items.response:
Got it: no new car in 2026, the money goes to the kitchen renovation, and EVs get another look in 2028. I'll unsubscribe you from the Mazda dealer's trade-in emails and Mazda marketing lists, but leave service reminders alone since the CX-5 is staying.
Action: find the unsubscribe links in the dealer emails, unsubscribe, and tell you which senders I cleared.

I don't have your collection schedule saved, so I don't want to guess the day. Holiday weeks usually push pickup back by a day, so it may have shifted this week.
Action: check the City of Toronto collection calendar for your address and tell you the green bin day for this week.

That's a lot, and being the one who bends every time is exhausting. Venting heard, and I'll make this part as painless as I can.
Action: look up Toronto to Montreal options for Thu the 8th (out in the morning, back in time for dinner), confirm the month and the meeting time and address with you, then send you the best two itineraries.

Sure. I don't have a record of your specific weak spots, so I'll start with the usual trouble areas (ser vs estar, por vs para, preterite vs imperfect, noun gender exceptions) and you can tell me what to swap in.
Action: send a 10-question warm-up quiz now, then adjust it for tonight's class with Carlos based on what you miss.

Morning! Snow in March is rude, and yes, it does feel like a bit of a liar. Hope the coffee is strong.
Action: nothing needed yet; tell me what's on your plate today and I'll start there.

A 40 minute bag wait plus a forgotten swim shirt and stuffie is a rough combo. I don't have your packing preferences saved, so I don't want to guess how you like to do it.
Action: ask you to tell me the rule in a sentence or two, save it, and then build a checklist for the trip home that includes Leo's swim shirt and stuffie.

Pastel de nata comes from Lisbon, Portugal, from the Belem neighbourhood. Monks at the Jeronimos Monastery made them in the early 1800s, and the Pasteis de Belem bakery has sold them since 1837. The kid version for Leo: the monks had lots of leftover egg yolks, because the whites were used to starch clothes.
Action: none needed; I can write it up as a short Leo-friendly story if you like.

That's a real accomplishment. Shipping Instant Payouts at Lumen Pay in May 2026, your first project led end to end as a senior PM, and it worked. Be proud of it.
Action: offer to save it in a wins note so it's handy for your next self-review.

The offsite is Thu 12 Nov. I need to confirm today's date to count properly, and I'd skip weekends and flag any holidays in between.
Action: check today's date and your calendar, count business days from tomorrow to Thu 12 Nov, and send you the number with the key deadlines in between.

I can't put a GA date in a note to Olivia until Aisha Rahman has signed off, and the note should say 'target', not 'launch date'. I can draft the note now with a placeholder and short paragraphs, using 'merchant' wording and no em dashes.
Action: ask Aisha to confirm the GA target, and hold the draft to Olivia until she does.

You're right, it used to be late January. The NFL season got longer (the 2001 season, then 9/11 pushed the 2002 game into February, and the 17-game season from 2021 locked in the second Sunday of February). Sunday is simply when the biggest TV audience is available.
Action: none needed.

I don't have next week's calendar in front of me, so I'll pull it rather than guess.
Action: check the family calendar and your work calendar for next week and send you a day-by-day rundown, with any clashes flagged.

Posting the Slack message to #payouts-launch now. I don't have Tom's favourite whisky saved, so I won't guess.
Action: post the draft, then search your notes and email for any mention of his whisky and come back with what I find, or ask you if there's nothing.

Will do. I'll say yes to Hannah and put pancakes at Hannah's on Sunday at 9:00 on the 'Okafor-Malhotra family' calendar after checking it for conflicts.
Action: check the family calendar for Sunday, add the event, text Hannah yes, and tell you if anything clashes.

Noted: your mid-year performance self-review in Lattice is due 2026-07-10.
Action: set a reminder next week to start it, and another reminder the week of 6 Jul to finish and submit before the Fri 10 Jul deadline.

Here's a draft Priya can send: 'Thanks for the updated direction. Since the brief has now changed twice since the design was approved, the revised drawings fall outside our original scope. We'll send a short change order covering the additional hours, and once it's signed we'll confirm a delivery date. Happy to talk it through.'
Action: send you this draft, and refine the tone or add the client's name and hour estimate once Priya gives them.

Will do. I'll book 30 minutes as you asked, in the afternoon of the 13th, with Diego and Aisha, and put an agenda in the invite.
Action: check their availability, book the slot with agenda: 1) walk through the new onboarding flows, 2) questions and feedback, 3) next steps and owners, then confirm the time with you.

Added.
Action: create a weekly recurring event, Leo swim lessons, Tuesdays 5:30 pm, Pam McConnell Aquatic Centre in Regent Park, starting tomorrow.

Ha, honestly a fair question. Very big cake needed. You've earned a sit-down after that day.
Action: nothing more tonight unless you want me to take something off your list.

Living without a kitchen for weeks is genuinely draining, and I'm here to talk. On the floor: skip the broom, it pushes fine dust around and any grit can scratch. Go over it with a vacuum on the hard floor setting with a soft brush head (no beater bar), then a barely damp microfiber mop and dry it right away.
Action: add microfiber mop pads to your shopping list, and I'm happy to keep listening.

Merry belated Christmas! That sounds like the perfect Boxing Day: pyjamas, a Lego truck built three times, and a sleeping Sam and Biscuit.
Action: nothing needed; tell me if you want me to plan anything for the rest of the day.

Both are set. Your Tom comments reminder goes in Friday morning, so it's done before the weekend. Saturday morning is busy: your 7:00 run with Marcus, and Leo's soccer arrival at 8:45 if the season is on, so the library fits best after that.
Action: set a Friday reminder to send Tom your strategy memo comments and a Saturday reminder for the Pape branch library books, after checking the branch's Saturday hours.

I don't have a note on Leo's current obsessions, and I don't want to guess about food restrictions for a parcel. The only recent thing I can see is the giant cushion fort that Biscuit has claimed.
Action: search your notes and messages for Leo's current interests and any allergies, then draft a reply to Grace for you to send.

Nut-free camp lunches: 1) turkey and cheese roll-ups with fruit and crackers, 2) pasta salad with cucumber and cheese, 3) mini pizza bagels, 4) chicken quesadilla strips with salsa, 5) hummus wrap with veggie sticks. I'd skip pesto and granola bars, and check labels. I don't have the Biscuit and ambulance conversation in front of me, so I can't say what you asked.
Action: search past chats for the Biscuit and ambulance question, and tell you what I find or ask you to remind me.

On it. The most recent out-of-office I have is the one for Fri 22 May with you back Mon 25 May and Aisha Rahman covering payouts, so I'll assume that's the one. I'll end it before tomorrow morning and change the message to say you're back but catching up.
Action: check which out-of-office is active, end it effective tomorrow morning, and update the text to 'I'm back and catching up on email, I'll reply as soon as I can.'

Booking it now: a 25 minute onboarding design review with Aisha and Diego on Thu 26 Nov at 10:00, with your agenda in the invite.
Action: check availability for all three, send the invite with agenda: 1) KYC retry screens, 2) empty states, 3) open questions, and confirm.

Great. I'll put together a short note Tanvi can use, covering that rent increases above the guideline need Landlord and Tenant Board approval, that she gets 90 days' notice on an N1 form, and that she can pay the guideline amount if no application is filed.
Action: create the note with links to the official Ontario and Landlord and Tenant Board pages, then send it to you to forward.

You're welcome. Your holds at Pape/Danforth are ready until Sat 25 Apr, and the renewals are running. Tom still needs the link to the beta merchant numbers before his exec sync tomorrow morning.
Action: nudge you after dinner about Tom's link.

Welcome to Vancouver! What you actually paid was $1,947.66 CAD for the three of you on AC117 and AC120. I don't have the earlier pre-booking search or the Lafourcade song piece in front of me, so I'll look for both rather than guess.
Action: search past chats and notes for the pre-booking flight search and the Lafourcade song piece, then send both to you so you can share with Kabir and Mei.

Try: 'If a payout fails because of a bank-side error, the system shall automatically retry it without merchant action.' It drops the stacked clauses and keeps the requirement clear.
Action: apply this edit to the PRD if you want it, and flag any other sentences that read the same way.

I don't have the reasons in front of me, and I don't want to reconstruct them from memory. Better to pull the actual notes.
Action: search your notes and email for the reno contractor comparison (quotes, references, timelines) and send Sam a short summary of why Nate won.

I'll pull the open payouts tickets and group them by the Q4 workstreams (reconciliation CSV export v2, payout status webhooks, instant payout fee experiment). The risks I'd already watch for December are the bank partner API migration in November and thin capacity at about 2.5 engineers, but I'll check against the tickets.
Action: query Linear for open payouts tickets, group by workstream, and flag at-risk items with the reason for each.

Let's use real numbers before deciding. I'd compare your last 12 months of Costco spend and trips with the membership fee and any reward you get back, and see if a cheaper tier makes sense.
Action: pull your Costco receipts and membership details, calculate spend against the fee, and give you a keep, downgrade or cancel recommendation.

Booking it: a 25 minute call with Olivia and Aisha on the 9th at 3:30 pm, with your agenda in the invite. I'll keep the wording to 'target' for GA dates.
Action: check availability, send the invite for 15:30 to 15:55 on the 9th with the agenda: 1) where certification stands, 2) what sales can and can't say, 3) next checkpoint.

On it. I'll build a family style spread from Pai on Duncan for three, under $100 including tax and delivery, delivered at 6:00. Since Thai food often has nuts, tell me if anyone has an allergy I should avoid.
Action: put together a surprise order under $100, check the menu for nuts, and place it for 18:00 delivery once you confirm no allergies.

Have a great dinner! Kits pool is open tomorrow from 7:00 to 20:45, with lanes closed until 9:00, so go after that.
Action: nothing needed; I'll remind you in the morning about pool hours and the swim shirt on Leo's checklist.

I'll check last night's Raptors game so I don't guess the score.
Action: search for last night's Raptors final score and send it to you with the key takeaway for Sam.

Sorry, that's annoying. I don't have your auto insurer or policy number to hand, so I'll find those first. Meanwhile, take photos of the damage and the lot, and tell Loblaws customer service, since a hit-and-run may need a police report.
Action: search your email and notes for the policy documents, and start a claim once I have the details. I'll also check whether the repair cost is likely to exceed your deductible.

Ha, the coat at your desk says it all. Hopefully facilities warms it up soon.
Action: still checking your calendar for anything on the 22nd that needs moving for your out-of-office, and I'll report back.

Heads up: Wen Li needs requests through #data-requests with at least three business days of notice and a written metric definition, and the timing for Wednesday looks tight. I can draft the request with the definition now and also look at what Looker already shows for failed payouts.
Action: draft a #data-requests post (failed payouts by receiving bank, last 30 days) with a metric definition for your OK, and flag the short notice to Wen.

I can do that. I need the old pricing page URL, and ideally the new one, so I can search accurately.
Action: search your Drive and Notion docs for the old pricing page URL and list every doc that links to it with the new URL to swap in.

Sunday at 9:00 pm is your weekly video call with your mom, so an 8:30 to 10:00 spy series block would overlap it. For the mithai, I'll look for sugar-free options because of her diabetes.
Action: hold off on blocking until you choose (for example 9:45 onward, or after the call), and search for a Bandra or Mumbai shop that delivers sugar-free mithai.

No, damage deposits aren't allowed in Ontario. A landlord can only take a last month's rent deposit, and if Diego paid a separate damage deposit he can ask for it back. For real damage, the landlord has to apply to the Landlord and Tenant Board, and scuffed walls are usually normal wear and tear.
Action: draft a short note for Diego with the plain-language steps and links to forward.

I'll pull this month's personal notes so you can see them all together.
Action: list your personal notes from this month with titles, dates and a one-line summary, grouped into themes you can merge or delete.

Sounds like a great trip for you and Leo. I need to confirm your exact dates and how you're getting there before booking. I'll find 3 nights of hotels in Drumheller for March break, the week of the 16th, and check Tyrrell tickets for Leo's age group.
Action: search Drumheller hotels for 3 nights that week and the Tyrrell Museum child ticket price, then send you 3 options before booking anything.
